about:
# Stay-Sheathed-Lite
Just a small simple script to check and make sure your weapon remains sheathed.

Small addon I thought I might as well share that sheaths your weapon. It's a very simple script and likely incompatible with Stay Unsheathed / Sheath. It doesn't have any extra options or customisation, so use one of the others if that's what you want.

 

### Known Issues

Sometimes it goes into a sort of "ending loop" for hunters. idk why.

**TBC Classic**: Because of how WoW handles sheath in olden times, it'll sheath and bring out your ranged/thrown/wand weapon or whatnot. I have it do a "double check" to try and also sheath that as well.

 

*Maybe future idea:*

*Add ability for quick slash command that will temporarily stop sheathing function.*

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found [here](https://discord.gg/tA4rrmjPp8).
